texts.name: The Thornfold
texts.blurb: Thorns folded round a wood that fold again.

raw.name: The wood walks
raw.blurb: Every 114 seconds roots close 3 ways and open 3 others. A green glow marks the ways that are open.

people.name: The Moss-Abbess
greet: Careful, climber. The wood walks. Two wisps are bound in it, and the Antler King waits at its heart, far to the north. Free the wisps, cut the roots that feed him, and his door opens.

people.name: The Path-Lighter
greet: I lose things in this wood, and the wood keeps them. Maybe you can bring them back.

people.name: The Kiln-Mother
greet: You found the charcoal clearing? Then you can stand by it a while.

people.name: The Charm-Pedlar
greet: Shards for what you need. The wood takes nothing back, so I take shards.

quests.name: The Heart of the Wood
intro: Clear the thorn brake, and its wisp follows you: lead it to the heart. Then the old stones: the Stag-Crowned guards the second wisp. Last, cut the three roots that feed the Antler King, and his door opens.
outro: The wisps are home, the roots are cut. The Antler King’s door stands open, far in the north. Rest first, then go in.

steps.text: Lead the wisp from the thorn brake to the heart
steps.name: The wisp

steps.text: Lead the wisp from the old stones to the heart
steps.name: The wisp

steps.text: Cut the three roots that feed the heart
Go to the Antler King’s door

quests.name: The Lantern Thief
intro: The Lantern Thief walks round the hollow oak. Fell it and the wood grows calmer.
outro: A relic from the old wood. Keep it.

quests.name: Grandmother Thorn
intro: Grandmother Thorn walks the far glades. Nobody lights the lamps while it does.

quests.name: The Spore Lamps
intro: Two spore lamps: one at the wayside shrine, one at the spring. Light both, stand by each a moment, and I can see the paths move.
outro: Now I can see. Take this, it was in the moss.

quests.name: The Lost Spade
intro: Bram the younger dropped a spade in the thicket and will not go back for it. Carry it to the camp fire. A hit and you drop it.

steps.text: Bring the spade from the thicket to the fire

quests.name: The Burners’ Watch
intro: My stacks lie past the charcoal clearing. Find them, then hold the clearing while I bring the charcoal in: the hounds smell the smoke.
outro: All in, and dry. Take this.

steps.text: Hold the clearing while the charcoal comes in

doors.name: The Antler King’s door
doors.locked: Roots hold the door shut. The Moss-Abbess has a quest about the wisps.

doors.name: The gate up
doors.locked: The gate is sealed. Its warden answers only once the Antler King has fallen.

lines: Another climber. I am Sirix. Walk into the thicket behind me and we see who is better. Win, and I fight beside you.

lore.name: The root stone
text: Every tree here was planted by someone who meant to come back.
The trees remember. The planters do not.

hound.name: Bark hound
hound.blurb: Fast, and hunts in a pack.

named1.name: The Lantern Thief
named1.blurb: Walks round the old oak and strikes hard.

named2.name: Grandmother Thorn
named2.blurb: Walks the far glades and strikes hard.

root.name: Feeding root
root.blurb: A root that feeds the heart. It cannot move; it throws thorns.

ruler.name: The Antler King
ruler.title: Crowned in branches
ruler.line: Cut the roots that feed it; it stands open when none is left
